capabilities: Render dashboard blocks (stats, progress, heatmap, chart, countdown, today, tiles) from note frontmatter
Generate and edit dashboard blocks as plain YAML via an installable AI agent skill
Insert working example blocks without an agent via a command
Redraw blocks automatically when notes change and resolve note dates from names or properties
Report broken blocks with line numbers and did-you-mean suggestions
extras: README warns that your AI agent reads notes and sends them to its model provider, and that .dashy/vault-profile.md holds sample property values; Dashy itself makes no network requests apart from https tile images. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Plain YAML, no JavaScript, no Dataview.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dashboards, and existing approaches rely on JavaScript or Dataview queries that are hard to write and often don't work on mobile.

relations.evidence: Plain YAML, no JavaScript, no Dataview.
Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents.

requires.name: AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar)

summary: YAML-block dashboard builder that renders charts, streaks, heatmaps and goals from note properties, with an AI agent to write the blocks for you.
